title: 第十九章 校运动会第二十章 游戏什么的早腻了
content_zh:
最新网址：学校运动会前几天，王跃终于把手里的钱花出去了。纠结了很久，以王跃的阅历，最后发现，做什么都没有买房子更安全的赚钱方式。
于是王跃的柜子里，又2个红本本，其中有一个两居，就在大学城不远那个小区里。
看着这些本本，王跃就想着，这要是能带入现实世界多好。
不过现在想想，其实他回现实世界了，也可以接活的，下班一晚上能挣好多钱呢，越想，眼睛里的小星星越亮。
离学校不远那个两居，王跃决定自己住。其实王跃就是觉得，建筑这个行业太广了，而他又太陌生了，不知道。
这个世界里又没有两个大神对他言传身教。哎，有点想那个世界了。不知道ko和郝眉师兄咋样了！
王跃就设计了一套室内装修图纸，找了一个看起来靠谱的装修公司就施工了。老板看王跃的图纸，仿佛打开了新世界大门，原来厨房还可以这么干，原来……
校运动会期间，王跃被拉去参加篮球比赛，班里的人都知道这货打球厉害归厉害，就是太独。所以一般就让他打替补，大家累的时候，让他上去撒撒欢。
可是你别说，他们的团队篮球，就是没有“王·布莱恩特·跃”招人喜欢，王跃上场的时候，对方的女生有几个都为他的进球欢呼。太帅了有木有！
一路砍瓜切菜，有惊无险的，最后拿到了一年级组冠军。而王跃在一次下场休息的时候，接过郑微递过来的水，给他吹自己当年的外号。
后来，没多久先是系里，后来是院里，再后来全校都有人知道土木工程系有一个篮球打的特别帅气的男生，外号“王·布莱恩特”！
当然。这是女生认为的。男生都觉得他那骚气十足的球风，应该叫“王布里！”王跃听说后，十分的无语，马政委打球十分团队好不！
篮球决赛结束的当天，土木工程系和建筑设计系，在女子4x100米接力赛上相遇。
张开和许开阳两个货竟然跑到王跃身边一起给郑微加油，这让建筑设计系的师兄们怒骂这俩货是叛徒。
郑微的最后的一棒，成功的让人知道了，谁才是土木工程系最野的丫头。不过，还是输了比赛。
当王跃听到陈孝正说出的判定输赢的理由，也是目瞪口呆。脑子里瞬间出现001除以百米速度，反正也就不到1毫秒。
这样方面说女孩子好吗？特别是郑微那羞愤欲绝的表情，于是，正直的王跃不干了，他绝对不承认这一瞬间心疼了。
耍赖皮咱怕过谁。就今天那个风速，陈孝正拉的线都是个弧线，找理由简直不要太多了。
“裁判，我有意见！”王跃一副乖宝宝的样子，跑到裁判员的身边。
“说吧，你对判罚结果有异议？”充当裁判员的学生会工作人员一脸诧异的看着王跃，大一敢这么顶牛的还真不多。

“对啊，裁判员！刚哪位说差距一厘米的是建筑设计系的，他的话不具有可信性！”王跃说的有理有据。
“他是建筑设计系的？”和王跃说话的裁判员一听这情况，就问另外的几个工作人员。
里面有一个认出了陈孝正，毕竟那是几个教授经常夸赞的人。
“是，他是建筑设计系的陈孝正！”
得到肯定的答案后，裁判员麻爪了。总不能再跑一次吧！
content_en:
Latest website: A few days before the school sports meeting, Wang Yue finally spent his money. After struggling for a long time, based on Wang Yue's experience, he finally found that there was no safer way to make money by buying a house.
So in Wang Yue's cabinet, there were two more red books, one of which was a two-bedroom apartment in a community not far from the university town.
Looking at these books, Wang Yue thought, it would be great if this could be brought into the real world.
But now that I think about it, he is actually back in the real world and can take on jobs. He can earn a lot of money in one night after get off work. The more he thinks about it, the brighter the little stars in his eyes become.
Wang Yue decided to live in the two-bedroom apartment not far from the school by himself. In fact, Wang Yue just feels that the construction industry is too broad, and he is too unfamiliar to know about it.
There are no two great gods in this world who can teach him through words and deeds. Hey, I kind of miss that world. I don’t know what’s going on with KO and senior brother Hao Mei!
Wang Yue designed a set of interior decoration drawings, found a decoration company that seemed reliable, and started the construction. When the boss looked at Wang Yue's drawings, it seemed as if he had opened the door to a new world. It turns out that the kitchen can still be used like this. It turns out...
During the school sports meeting, Wang Yue was dragged to participate in the basketball game. Everyone in the class knew that this guy was very good at playing, but he was too independent. So I usually let him play as a substitute, and when everyone is tired, let him come up and have some fun.
But don't tell me, their team basketball is not as popular as "Wang Bryant Yue". When Wang Yue came on the court, several of the other girls cheered for his goals. He's so handsome, isn't he?
Cutting melons and vegetables all the way, with no near misses, and finally won the championship of the first grade group. During a break, Wang Yue took the water from Zheng Wei and gave him his nickname from back then.
Later, it didn’t take long for everyone first in the department, then in the college, and then the whole school to know that there was a particularly handsome boy in the Department of Civil Engineering who played basketball, nicknamed “King Bryant”!
certainly. This is what girls think. The boys all thought that because of his sultry playing style, he should be called "Wang Buri!" Wang Yue was speechless after hearing about it. Political Commissar Ma played very well as a team!
On the day after the basketball finals, the Department of Civil Engineering and the Department of Architectural Design met in the women's 4x100m relay race.
Zhang Kaiyang and Xu Kaiyang actually ran to Wang Yue's side to cheer Zheng Wei together, which made the senior fellows in the Department of Architecture and Design angrily call these two traitors.
Zheng Wei's last attack successfully made it known who was the wildest girl in the civil engineering department. However, the game was still lost.
When Wang Yue heard Chen Xiaozheng's reasons for determining victory or defeat, he was stunned. 001 divided by the speed of 100 meters suddenly appeared in my mind, which was less than 1 millisecond anyway.
Is it okay to talk about girls in this way? Especially Zheng Wei's expression of shame and anger, so the upright Wang Yue quit. He would never admit that he felt distressed at this moment.
Who are we afraid of being a shameless person? At today's wind speed, the line Chen Xiaozheng pulled was an arc, so he didn't need too many excuses.
"Referee, I have a problem!" Wang Yue ran to the referee like a good boy.
"Tell me, do you have any objection to the penalty result?" The student union staff member who acted as the referee looked at Wang Yue in surprise. Not many freshmen dared to challenge him like this.
"That's right, referee! Who just said that the one with a one centimeter gap was from the Department of Architectural Design? His words are not credible!" Wang Yue said with reason.
"Is he from the Department of Architectural Design?" The referee who was talking to Wang Yue asked several other staff members upon hearing this.
One of them recognized Chen Xiaozheng. After all, he was someone whom several professors often praised.
"Yes, he is Chen Xiaozheng from the Department of Architectural Design!"
After getting the affirmative answer, the referee was numb. You can’t run again!
